card.name: Zeros in ISBNs and tiny decimals
card.fires_on: The digit 0 or the hyphen or point right after a leading 0, in ISBN numbers and in very small decimal values such as p-values with several zeros.

modes.label: ISBN start
modes.description: The hyphen or next zero after an ISBN that begins with 0 in book citations.

modes.label: Small decimals
modes.description: A zero or the decimal point inside numbers like 0.0008 or 0.00001.

card.plain: It fires on the zeros and punctuation at the start of book ISBN numbers and in very small decimal numbers.
